title: Estate EIN - federal basics
facts: A decedent's estate is generally a separate tax entity from the deceased individual and may need its own Employer Identification Number.
An estate should not simply continue using the deceased person's Social Security number as the estate's taxpayer identification number.
The responsible fiduciary can apply for an EIN through IRS procedures.
Whether the estate must file a federal income tax return is a separate question from whether an EIN is obtained.
